Local

LOH-kuhl · adjective

Hear It

What It Means

Local is belonging to or existing in the area nearby.

We buy sweet corn from the local farm stand every August.

Worked Example

The local news showed our school's food drive on TV.

The news covers stories from our own area. Things from the area close by are local.

How Local Sits Among Its Neighbors

Synonyms — open each to see how it differs

nearby

nearby: close to where you are

neighborhood

neighborhood: of the streets around your home

Antonyms

distant

distant: far away from here

nationwide

nationwide: across the whole country

How Strong Is It? — Nearby → Hometown → local

Nearby vs. local

Nearby vs. local: Nearby is milder: a nearby town is close, but it is not your own.

Hometown vs. local

Hometown vs. local: Hometown is stronger: your hometown team is not just close by - it is yours.
